recent_summaries.text:
- Uday coaches the Milpitas Lions U12 soccer team.
- The team plays on Saturday mornings at Cesar Chavez Park.
- The team colors are green and white.
- Priya, the assistant coach, cannot attend games in November.
- No peanut snacks are allowed at team events due to Uday's peanut allergy.
- The next fixture is on November 1st at 6pm against the San Jose Tigers.
